root_cause_assessment.finding: The cddd fast-feedback command selected Playwright UAT targets through the ci-only/shared-only logic_guardrails early-return branches, which bypassed the existing eligibility predicate. Those jobs invoked pytest without the managed live-server wrapper, so Playwright setup failed when localhost:8000 was unavailable.

The Playwright errors reported connection refusal at http://localhost:8000/account/login/. This evidence supports a selector/harness mismatch and is not product-rendering evidence.
